predictions.articleTitle: Central African Republic vs Benin Match Analysis & Preview: Can CAR Contain Benin's Attack?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Benin's superior Group F scoring rate, coaching continuity, and neutral-venue advantage point toward an away win in a competitive multi-goal fixture.
possibilityAssessment: Away Win — Benin's 2.33 goals-per-game Group F attack, 1,385-day coaching continuity, and 170-point Elo edge systematically overpower a winless Central African Republic side conceding 2.67 goals per qualifier at a neutral venue in Douala (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

Over 2.5 Total Goals — Combined goal expectancy of 3.33 and Benin's three-match streak of scoring multiple goals while conceding once in every qualifier support a 3-to-4 goal match script (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Both Teams to Score in a Narrow Away Win (1:2) — Louis Mafouta and Geoffrey Kondogbia give CAR sufficient attacking bite to breach a Benin back line with zero Group F clean sheets even in defeat (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Benin's clinical attack tests Central African Republic's fragile neutral-venue defense.

spf.comment: Projected 1:2 and 1:3 scorelines reflect Benin's clear attacking and structural edge over a winless CAR defense on neutral turf.

over_under.comment: A 3.33 combined goal lambda, CAR's 2.67 goals conceded per qualifier, and Benin's lack of Group F clean sheets favor three or more goals.

score.comment: 1:2 captures a tighter neutral-venue turnaround with CAR scoring via Mafouta, while 1:3 reflects late transition punishment if CAR chase points.

goals.comment: Goal distribution clusters around three and four goals given Benin's 2.50 lambda and CAR's persistent defensive vulnerability.

bqc.comment: Benin's early sharpness favors Loss-Loss from the home perspective, with Draw-Loss covering a tighter opening 45 minutes if CAR sit deep.
